title: Connect newsletter signups to an email service
description: No signup backend exists. Choose a provider (or a Papyrus endpoint), set `newsletter.signupEndpoint` in `web/site-config.json`; the forms then POST `{email, lists, topics, page}` as JSON and show the success state and toast. Needs double opt-in, the precedential-alerts list, and a privacy policy page (the design links one).

comments.author: home
comments.text: Blocked on Papyrus initiative PPY-31455f (Outbound newsletters), milestone M1 PPY-08dbd8: SES per site, double opt-in signup endpoint, subscriber records, one-click unsubscribe. Papyrus builds it; this site then sets newsletter.signupEndpoint.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Contact and signup forms now post to the Papyrus public form endpoint (a67b171). Newsletter delivery is still open: newsletter.signupEndpoint stays null and /subscribe/ says signups are not open.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Newsletters are live (2026-10-22) on the Papyrus newsletter plugin, Papyrus 5.22.0 (Distinctive-web #10, #11). Sending is SES on distinctive-mark.com (DKIM, SPF, DMARC p=none) from Distinctive Mark <newsletter@distinctive-mark.com>. Lists: weekly (The Docket: drafted Sunday 12:00 ET, an admin approves each issue for Monday 7:00 ET, sent issues archived at /docket/) and ruling-alerts (one email per newly published ruling, each approved by an admin). Signup forms post to /api/newsletter/subscribe with double opt-in, consent wording, honeypot and render time; every email has one-click unsubscribe. Also: cms.siteOrigin set (PAPYRUS_SITE_ORIGIN), and the edge no longer turns /api errors into the 404 page (Papyrus #560 applied to papyrus-edge-distinctive-mark). Verified with the SES mailbox simulator: success pending confirmation, bounce and complaint suppressed and unsubscribed, alarms OK, site not paused. Admins approve issues and alerts in the newsroom Newsletter panel.
